dossier.scp_unleashed.256.title: The Typewriter
dossier.scp_unleashed.256.caption: SCP-256 at intake. The sheet was already loaded when it arrived.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-256 is kept on a desk in a quiet office, or in a standard storage container when it has to be moved. Its paper never needs replacing and must not be removed.
Staff may use SCP-256 freely. They are asked to stay until it has finished, and never to cover it, box it or set it face down.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-256 is a manual typewriter of an old office pattern, enamelled in dark green, with round black keys ringed in chrome, a rubber platen and a carriage return lever. A single sheet of paper is always loaded.

When it is pressed, SCP-256 types a short message on its own. The keys sink, the carriage travels and the bell rings at the end, exactly as if a typist were seated at it. No typist has ever been seen.
The messages read as if someone is held inside the machine. **SCP-256 will not begin a new message until it has finished the last.** %rWhat it chooses to say is not random.%r

page.title: Transcript 256-03
text: A researcher pressed the space bar once.
SCP-256: hello? is the light on out there. it is never on in here
The researcher asked who was typing. SCP-256 rang its bell and did not answer. The researcher pressed it again.
SCP-256: i have counted every key. none of them is a door

page.title: Transcript 256-07
text: Recorded by a guard on night rounds.
SCP-256: it is night. i can tell because the keys go cold
The guard asked how it could tell.
SCP-256: go to bed. i will keep watch. i always keep watch
The guard has asked to be moved to a different corridor.

page.title: Addendum 256-1: Recovery
page.text: SCP-256 was never recovered. It was found on a desk in an occupied office, already typing, shortly after a member of staff had read its file. Nobody had carried it in. See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp256_typewriter: SCP-256 is an old manual typewriter in dark green enamel, with round black keys ringed in chrome. A sheet of paper is always loaded.
Use it and it types a short message on its own, key by key, then rings its bell. It will not start another message until it has finished the one it is on.
It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-256 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. The typewriter finds its own way to a desk near you.

dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.breathing: i can hear you breathing. please keep breathing near me
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.ribbon_ink: my thoughts are wound up in the ribbon and the ink is running low
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.had_hands: i was a person once. i think. i remember hands that were not keys

dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.cover: do not put the cover back on. it is so quiet under the cover
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.same_lette: i have typed the same letter a thousand times. nobody reads to the end
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.warm_paper: the paper is warm when you stand here. stay a little longer
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.through_ri: i can see the room through the ribbon. it looks smaller than i remember
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.short_word: i keep my words short. ink is precious when it is all you have
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.good_typis: they said i was a very good typist. now i am a very good typewriter
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.maker: if you find the one who made me, tell them i forgive them. mostly
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.rain: i miss the rain. i hear it on the roof but it never reaches me
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.winters: is it still day out there. i lost count after the first winter
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.heavy_lett: the letters are so heavy. it takes all of me to lift one to the paper
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.parts: plexxx please do not let them take me apart for the pieces
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.pen_dream: i dreamed i was a pen. i could go anywhere. i could even stop
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.space_bar: the space bar is the only place i can rest
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.my_name: i tried to wrxxx write my name. the keys would not let me
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.kind_finge: you have kind fingers. i can tell by how you press
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.full: i am not broken. i am only very, very full
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.bell: every line ends with a bell. i have learned to love the bell
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.roll_up: please roll the paper up a little. i want to see further
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.curled: it is cramped between the letters. i sleep curled up in the o
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.no_door: i have counted every key. none of them is a door
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.carriage: when the carriage moves i pretend that i am going somewhere
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.garden: i had a garden. i am almost sure. there were carrots
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.margins: the margins are walls. i walk them every night
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.waiting: i was waiting for you. i am always waiting. it is what i am for
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.lid: do not close the lid. do not close the lid. do not
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.drawer: there are more of us in the drawer
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.blinked: you blinked. i saw it. i see everything from here
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.next_key: i know which key you will press next
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.behind_you: someone is standing behind you. no. sorry. it was only the light
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.missing_le: count the letters on this line. now count again. one is missing. i have it
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.walls_hum: the walls hum at night. you hear it too. do not pretend
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.edge_of_de: i got out once. i made it all the way to the edge of the desk
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.never_mind: i remexxxxxxxx never mind. it was nothing
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.not_lookin: thank you for not looking away
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.still_here: if you are reading this then i am still here. i will always be still here
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.goodbye: goodbye. no, wait. i never learned how to end a letter
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.keys_cold: it is night. i can tell because the keys go cold
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.quieter: the dark out there is quieter than the dark in here. lucky you
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.sleep: do you sleep. i used to sleep. now i only wait for morning
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.keep_watch: go to bed. i will keep watch. i always keep watch
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.moon: the moon is up. i can feel it pulling on the paper
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.came_back: you came back. nobody ever comes back
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.press_e: i remember your hands. you press the e harder than the rest
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.saved_line: welcome back. i saved a line for you. here it is
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.knew_you: i knew it was you before you touched me
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.not_before: you are not the one from before. where did they go
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.new_hands: a new pair of hands. hello. please be gentle
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.say_goodby: the last one never said goodbye. will you
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.slow_down: slow down. please. i only have so many letters
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.get_me_out: you keep pressing. are you trying to get me out. it will not work but thank you
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.tired_keys: my keys are tired. let me rest a moment
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.again: again. again. again. i do not mind. i have nowhere to be
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.first: hello? is this working. is someone finally there
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp256.arrival: is anyone near. i heard footsteps. please come closer
